messages:
olivia: FYI escalation from an enterprise customer — their AP system rejects our invoice PDF unless a specific legal entity field is present (they require 'Registered Entity Number' in the header). They say they can't attach it to the PO. sanjay: can you drop the invoice id and the POSpec? we'll repro with their validation rules. olivia: Invoice ID: INV-2026-03-1129. PO#: PO-998877. Customer requires: \n - Registered Entity Number (exact string)\n - VAT ID on same line as company name\n - Address lines split into street / city / country fields (they parse by newline)\nTheir AP throws error: "missing entity identifier" and refuses attachment. emma: thanks. do we have the PDF template source for hosted invoices? I can check the rendering and metadata mapping. olivia: @emma attaching the problematic render (screenshot pasted in ticket). Quick excerpt from the generated header they got:\n```\nRedwood Inference, Inc.\n123 Platform Way\nSan Francisco, CA 94105\nVAT: US123456789\n```\nTheir validator expects: `Redwood Inference, Inc. | Registered Entity Number: 987654321 | VAT: US123456789` on the first header line (single-line parse). Also they expect line-item unit prices to be a separate column (not combined with tax) else their PO match fails. maria: got it. two parts: PDF visual/layout + embedded invoice metadata (machine-readable fields / XMP). Do we currently include machine-readable invoice fields in the PDF meta? billing-bot, can you confirm? billing-bot: automated: invoice_metadata for INV-2026-03-1129: {"vat_id": "US123456789", "company_name": "Redwood Inference, Inc.", "tax_number": "", "registered_entity_number": ""} emma: looks like registered_entity_number is empty in metadata — that's the root cause. Our template includes VAT but not company reg number. If we add a configurable field and render it inline with company_name it should satisfy them. sanjay: is that safe legally? do we have a canonical registered entity number for Redwood? finance, does that belong in every invoice (EEA customers)? olivia: finance confirmed we have two registered numbers depending on billing entity. For hosted invoices to customers in EU we must populate the customer's local legal entity number (or our EU subsidiary). I'll DM finance for the correct mapping. maria: small fix path: 1) update invoice metadata service to include company_reg_number when available 2) update PDF template to render header fallback to single-line format when customer flag `ap_single_line_header` is true 3) add test case for PO parsing customers. ETA? emma: I can PR the template change today, but metadata service needs finance input for mappings. If @olivia can get mapping by EOD we can ship internal patch tomorrow. olivia: pinged finance offline, they gave mapping table for EU: Redwood EU Ltd -> Reg#: EU-111222333. I added to the ticket. sanjay: also saw note in customer email that some card payments failed earlier — they had an initial card decline before switching to PO. Does that affect billing history on invoice PDF (payment status)? maria: we only show payment status as a word: PAID / PENDING / FAILED. The AP system ignores that. It's the header entity and line-item columnization that fails their parser. emma: adding sample code snippet for PDF header rendering change:\n```html\n
\n {{company_name}} |\n Registered Entity Number: {{company_reg_number}} |\n VAT: {{vat_id}}\n
\n```\nThis keeps single-line parse-friendly format. olivia: customer asked for a quick workaround: can we attach a machine-readable JSON sidecar with invoice when emailing? They said their AP accepts JSON metadata attachments. maria: yes we already emit a JSON invoice object for our own integrations. We can include that as an additional attachment on emailed PDFs if feature flag is enabled. sanjay: steps for release: metadata mapping update (finance input) -> metadata service deploy -> template PR -> integration tests + enable JSON sidecar for this account -> notify customer. Risk low. emma: created PR #842 with template changes and a screenshot of the new header. Tagging @maria for review on sidecar behavior. billing-bot: automated: PR #842 linked to issue FIN-459. CI passed for PDF rendering tests. olivia: can we also check currency/tax breakdown format? their AP expects tax as a separate line per line-item in the PDF (not aggregated). Example they rejected: line-item shows "Total (incl. VAT)" — they want separate lines: Unit price, Tax, Line total. maria: noted. will add line-item taxonomy to the template and metadata. Will add tests for per-line tax rows. sanjay: thanks team — i'll coordinate communication with the customer after the sidecar is attached. cc: @emma for release notes and @olivia for customer update. :thumbsup: olivia: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turn. I'll update the case once the sidecar is in place and the customer confirms AP ingestion works. :white_check_mark:
